newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Airlines files complaint vs UAL.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Airlines files complaint vs UAL.

text.p: Frontier Airlines Inc said on Tuesday that it filed a complaint with the U.S. Department of Justice alleging that UAL Corp's United Airlines engaged in "predatory, anticompetitive and monopolistic practices" at Denver International Airport.

Frontier Airlines said it asks the agency to investigate eight separate counts of potential antitrust violations that range from "capacity dumping" in markets served by competitors to alleged abuses relating to United's pricing practices.
The complaint alleged United Airlines provided "exclusive dealing" with corporate customers and commuter carriers.

In other sections of the 30-page complaint, Frontier alleged that United Airlines used "pricing discrimination" in sharply raising its ticket prices after driving low-fare competitors from its markets.
The complaint was prepared by University of Denver Law Professor Paul Stephen Dempsey, who also serves as vice chairman of Frontier's board of directors.
